content: Inter v4.1 (latest release, published 2024-11-16) has NO Bulgarian Cyrillic locl. Verified by parsing InterVariable.ttf GSUB: ScriptList contains only DFLT and latn (langsys CAT/MOL/ROM); there is no cyrl script record at all. The locl feature exists but maps only Scedilla->uni0218, scedilla->uni0219, uni0163->uni021B (Romanian/Moldavian) plus a Catalan ChainContext. HarfBuzz shaping of 'вгджзийклптцшщю' with language=bg vs language=ru yields identical glyph runs (0/15 differ). GitHub rsms/inter issue #562 requesting Bulgarian/Macedonian/Serbian localized Cyrillic remains OPEN (created 2023-04-22, last comment 2025-03-20, never closed). Inter DOES cover the full Bulgarian alphabet (248 Cyrillic codepoints) so text renders, just with Russian-convention letterforms.
